note: Every corpus project runs under CalcVBA's Safe policy unless listed here. An approval names the project id, route, SHA-256 of project.json, SHA-256 of each actual module input, and (for xlsm) SHA-256 of the actual workbook input and records the review of its triage that allows unguarded (Full) execution.
